description: List all asynchronous operations for the company. Non-admin users only see operations they created, unless the request is filtered to a company-readable operation type (for example `bulk_create_and_initialize_projects`) — either directly via `operation_type` or via `parent_id` — in which case matching operations are returned with a restricted payload that omits `result`, `error`, and `created_by_id`.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Return child operations of the specified parent operation.

parameters.name: filters[operation_type]
parameters.description: Return operations of the specified type.

parameters.name: filters[started_after]
parameters.description: Return operations that started after the started_after time.

parameters.name: filters[started_before]
parameters.description: Return operations that started before the started_before time.

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Return operations with the specified status.

result.description: Operation-specific result.  See the initiating API for details on the result format.

context.description: Opaque internal context information for the operation.

created_by_id.description: User ID of the user who created the operation

project_id.description: ID of the project the operation belongs to, if any

parent_id.description: ID of the parent operation, if this operation is a child of a batch operation
